'abstract contract CometCore is CometConfiguration, CometStorage, CometMath {'. Holds constants and presentValue/principalValue helpers (see separate facts).
Defines packed structs and market state (see comet_storage_user_basic, comet_storage_totals_basic, comet_storage_state_vars).

'contract CometMath {'. Errors: InvalidUInt64, InvalidUInt104, InvalidUInt128, InvalidInt104, InvalidInt256, NegativeNumber. Functions: safe64(uint)->uint64, safe104(uint)->uint104, safe128(uint)->uint128, signed104(uint104)->int104, signed256(uint256)->int256, unsigned104(int104)->uint104 (reverts NegativeNumber if n<0), unsigned256(int256)->uint256, toUInt8(bool)->uint8, toBool(uint8)->bool. NOTE: mulFactor/divFactor are NOT in CometMath; mulFactor lives in the Comet implementation: 'function mulFactor(uint n, uint factor) internal pure returns (uint) { return n * factor / FACTOR_SCALE; }'.

'contract CometConfiguration {' struct ExtConfiguration { bytes32 name32; bytes32 symbol32; } struct Configuration { address governor; address pauseGuardian; address baseToken; address baseTokenPriceFeed; address extensionDelegate; uint64 supplyKink; uint64 supplyPerYearInterestRateSlopeLow; uint64 supplyPerYearInterestRateSlopeHigh; uint64 supplyPerYearInterestRateBase; uint64 borrowKink; uint64 borrowPerYearInterestRateSlopeLow; uint64 borrowPerYearInterestRateSlopeHigh; uint64 borrowPerYearInterestRateBase; uint64 storeFrontPriceFactor; uint64 trackingIndexScale; uint64 baseTrackingSupplySpeed; uint64 baseTrackingBorrowSpeed; uint104 baseMinForRewards; uint104 baseBorrowMin; uint104 targetReserves; AssetConfig[] assetConfigs; } struct AssetConfig { address asset; address priceFeed; uint8 decimals; uint64 borrowCollateralFactor; uint64 liquidateCollateralFactor; uint64 liquidationFactor; uint128 supplyCap; }

Events: Supply(address indexed from, address indexed dst, uint amount); Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint amount); Withdraw(address indexed src, address indexed to, uint amount); SupplyCollateral(address indexed from, address indexed dst, address indexed asset, uint amount); TransferCollateral(address indexed from, address indexed to, address indexed asset, uint amount); WithdrawCollateral(address indexed src, address indexed to, address indexed asset, uint amount); AbsorbDebt(address indexed absorber, address indexed borrower, uint basePaidOut, uint usdValue); AbsorbCollateral(address indexed absorber, address indexed borrower, address indexed asset, uint collateralAbsorbed, uint usdValue); BuyCollateral(address indexed buyer, address indexed asset, uint baseAmount, uint collateralAmount); PauseAction(bool supplyPaused, bool transferPaused, bool withdrawPaused, bool absorbPaused, bool buyPaused); WithdrawReserves(address indexed to, uint amount). Getters: balanceOf(address) returns uint256; borrowBalanceOf(address) returns uint256; totalSupply(); totalBorrow(); getSupplyRate(uint utilization) returns uint64; getBorrowRate(uint) returns uint64; getUtilization() returns uint; baseScale() returns uint; trackingIndexScale() returns uint; supplyKink() returns uint; borrowKink() returns uint. NOTE: Comet Transfer events are emitted for present-value amounts; the ERC20 Transfer event does not carry the principal delta, so balances cannot be reconstructed from Transfer events alone without the index.

facts.value: presentValueSupply = uint256(principalValue_) * baseSupplyIndex_ / BASE_INDEX_SCALE; presentValueBorrow = uint256(principalValue_) * baseBorrowIndex_ / BASE_INDEX_SCALE; principalValueSupply = safe104((presentValue_ * BASE_INDEX_SCALE) / baseSupplyIndex_); principalValueBorrow = safe104((presentValue_ * BASE_INDEX_SCALE + baseBorrowIndex_ - 1) / baseBorrowIndex_)
facts.note: Verbatim: 'function presentValue(int104 principalValue_) internal view returns (int256) { if (principalValue_ >= 0) { return signed256(presentValueSupply(baseSupplyIndex, uint104(principalValue_))); } else { return -signed256(presentValueBorrow(baseBorrowIndex, uint104(-principalValue_))); } }' 'function presentValueSupply(uint64 baseSupplyIndex_, uint104 principalValue_) internal pure returns (uint256) { return uint256(principalValue_) * baseSupplyIndex_ / BASE_INDEX_SCALE; }' 'function presentValueBorrow(uint64 baseBorrowIndex_, uint104 principalValue_) internal pure returns (uint256) { return uint256(principalValue_) * baseBorrowIndex_ / BASE_INDEX_SCALE; }' 'function principalValue(int256 presentValue_) internal view returns (int104) { if (presentValue_ >= 0) { return signed104(principalValueSupply(baseSupplyIndex, uint256(presentValue_))); } else { return -signed104(principalValueBorrow(baseBorrowIndex, uint256(-presentValue_))); } }' 'function principalValueSupply(uint64 baseSupplyIndex_, uint256 presentValue_) internal pure returns (uint104) { return safe104((presentValue_ * BASE_INDEX_SCALE) / baseSupplyIndex_); }' 'function principalValueBorrow(uint64 baseBorrowIndex_, uint256 presentValue_) internal pure returns (uint104) { return safe104((presentValue_ * BASE_INDEX_SCALE + baseBorrowIndex_ - 1) / baseBorrowIndex_); }' Supply rounds down; borrow principal rounds up.

facts.value: function accruedInterestIndices(uint timeElapsed) internal view returns (uint64, uint64) { uint64 baseSupplyIndex_ = baseSupplyIndex; uint64 baseBorrowIndex_ = baseBorrowIndex; if (timeElapsed > 0) { uint utilization = getUtilization(); uint supplyRate = getSupplyRate(utilization); uint borrowRate = getBorrowRate(utilization); baseSupplyIndex_ += safe64(mulFactor(baseSupplyIndex_, supplyRate * timeElapsed)); baseBorrowIndex_ += safe64(mulFactor(baseBorrowIndex_, borrowRate * timeElapsed)); } return (baseSupplyIndex_, baseBorrowIndex_); }
facts.note: Verbatim. mulFactor(n, factor) = n * factor / FACTOR_SCALE, so newIndex = index + index * rate_per_second * timeElapsed / 1e18 (simple interest within an accrual interval, compounded at each accrueInternal). Storage is updated only in 'function accrueInternal() internal { uint40 now_ = getNowInternal(); uint timeElapsed = uint256(now_ - lastAccrualTime); if (timeElapsed > 0) { (baseSupplyIndex, baseBorrowIndex) = accruedInterestIndices(timeElapsed); if (totalSupplyBase >= baseMinForRewards) { trackingSupplyIndex += safe64(divBaseWei(baseTrackingSupplySpeed * timeElapsed, totalSupplyBase)); } if (totalBorrowBase >= baseMinForRewards) { trackingBorrowIndex += safe64(divBaseWei(baseTrackingBorrowSpeed * timeElapsed, totalBorrowBase)); } lastAccrualTime = now_; } }'. getNowInternal(): 'if (block.timestamp >= 2**40) revert TimestampTooLarge(); return uint40(block.timestamp);'. initializeStorage(): 'if (lastAccrualTime != 0) revert AlreadyInitialized(); lastAccrualTime = getNowInternal(); baseSupplyIndex = BASE_INDEX_SCALE; baseBorrowIndex = BASE_INDEX_SCALE;' (indices start at 1e15). Implication for a balance-state epoch: balanceOf at block N = principal * (baseSupplyIndex + baseSupplyIndex*supplyRate*(block.timestamp - lastAccrualTime)/1e18) / 1e15, where baseSupplyIndex/lastAccrualTime are storage at N; a Substreams replay needs storage changes (or exact re-derivation) of baseSupplyIndex, not just events.

facts.value: getSupplyRate: utilization <= supplyKink ? supplyPerSecondInterestRateBase + mulFactor(supplyPerSecondInterestRateSlopeLow, utilization) : supplyPerSecondInterestRateBase + mulFactor(supplyPerSecondInterestRateSlopeLow, supplyKink) + mulFactor(supplyPerSecondInterestRateSlopeHigh, (utilization - supplyKink)); getBorrowRate analogous with borrow* immutables; getUtilization = totalSupply_ == 0 ? 0 : totalBorrow_ * FACTOR_SCALE / totalSupply_
facts.note: Verbatim: 'function getSupplyRate(uint utilization) override public view returns (uint64) { if (utilization <= supplyKink) { return safe64(supplyPerSecondInterestRateBase + mulFactor(supplyPerSecondInterestRateSlopeLow, utilization)); } else { return safe64(supplyPerSecondInterestRateBase + mulFactor(supplyPerSecondInterestRateSlopeLow, supplyKink) + mulFactor(supplyPerSecondInterestRateSlopeHigh, (utilization - supplyKink))); } }' 'function getBorrowRate(uint utilization) override public view returns (uint64) { if (utilization <= borrowKink) { return safe64(borrowPerSecondInterestRateBase + mulFactor(borrowPerSecondInterestRateSlopeLow, utilization)); } else { return safe64(borrowPerSecondInterestRateBase + mulFactor(borrowPerSecondInterestRateSlopeLow, borrowKink) + mulFactor(borrowPerSecondInterestRateSlopeHigh, (utilization - borrowKink))); } }' 'function getUtilization() override public view returns (uint) { uint totalSupply_ = presentValueSupply(baseSupplyIndex, totalSupplyBase); uint totalBorrow_ = presentValueBorrow(baseBorrowIndex, totalBorrowBase); if (totalSupply_ == 0) { return 0; } else { return totalBorrow_ * FACTOR_SCALE / totalSupply_; } }'. Note getUtilization uses the STORED (un-accrued) indices. docs.compound.finance/interest-rates/ confirms the same kink formula and: rates are 'the decimal representation of a percentage scaled up by 10 ^ 18'; 'Supply APR = Supply Rate / (10 ^ 18) * Seconds Per Year * 100', 'Seconds Per Year = 60 * 60 * 24 * 365'; 'Interest accrues every second using the block timestamp.'

facts.value: uint public override immutable supplyKink; supplyPerSecondInterestRateSlopeLow; supplyPerSecondInterestRateSlopeHigh; supplyPerSecondInterestRateBase; borrowKink; borrowPerSecondInterestRateSlopeLow; borrowPerSecondInterestRateSlopeHigh; borrowPerSecondInterestRateBase (each '/// @dev uint64', declared as uint)
facts.note: Declared as 'uint public override immutable X;' each preceded by '/// @dev uint64' (the interface returns uint). Doc comments: supplyKink 'The point in the supply rates separating the low interest rate slope and the high interest rate slope (factor)'; supplyPerSecondInterestRateSlopeLow 'Per second supply interest rate slope applied when utilization is below kink (factor)'; ...SlopeHigh 'applied when utilization is above kink (factor)'; supplyPerSecondInterestRateBase 'Per second supply base interest rate (factor)'; borrow* symmetric. Constructor: 'supplyKink = config.supplyKink; supplyPerSecondInterestRateSlopeLow = config.supplyPerYearInterestRateSlopeLow / SECONDS_PER_YEAR; supplyPerSecondInterestRateSlopeHigh = config.supplyPerYearInterestRateSlopeHigh / SECONDS_PER_YEAR; supplyPerSecondInterestRateBase = config.supplyPerYearInterestRateBase / SECONDS_PER_YEAR; borrowKink = config.borrowKink; borrowPerSecondInterestRateSlopeLow = config.borrowPerYearInterestRateSlopeLow / SECONDS_PER_YEAR; borrowPerSecondInterestRateSlopeHigh = config.borrowPerYearInterestRateSlopeHigh / SECONDS_PER_YEAR; borrowPerSecondInterestRateBase = config.borrowPerYearInterestRateBase / SECONDS_PER_YEAR;' with 'uint64 internal constant SECONDS_PER_YEAR = 31_536_000;' (CometCore). Because these are immutables baked into the implementation, every governance rate change = new implementation deployed via Configurator/CometFactory and proxy upgrade; an indexer must re-read immutables (via getters) after each upgrade.

facts.value: baseScale = uint64(10 ** decimals_) where decimals_ = IERC20NonStandard(config.baseToken).decimals(); trackingIndexScale = config.trackingIndexScale (1e15 in all four market configs)
facts.note: Declarations: '/// @notice The scale for base token (must be less than 18 decimals) /// @dev uint64 uint public override immutable baseScale;' '/// @notice The scale for reward tracking /// @dev uint64 uint public override immutable trackingIndexScale;' '/// @notice The number of decimals for wrapped base token uint8 public override immutable decimals;'. Constructor: 'uint8 decimals_ = IERC20NonStandard(config.baseToken).decimals(); if (decimals_ > MAX_BASE_DECIMALS) revert BadDecimals(); ... decimals = decimals_; baseScale = uint64(10 ** decimals_); trackingIndexScale = config.trackingIndexScale; if (baseScale < BASE_ACCRUAL_SCALE) revert BadDecimals(); accrualDescaleFactor = baseScale / BASE_ACCRUAL_SCALE;'. So USDC/USDbC markets: decimals 6, baseScale 1e6; WETH market: decimals 18, baseScale 1e18. Other immutables: baseTrackingSupplySpeed, baseTrackingBorrowSpeed (@dev uint64, 'in trackingIndexScale'), baseMinForRewards (@dev uint104), baseBorrowMin, targetReserves, storeFrontPriceFactor (@dev uint64; constructor 'if (config.storeFrontPriceFactor > FACTOR_SCALE) revert BadDiscount();'), numAssets (uint8).

Exposed via CometExt (contracts/CometExt.sol, 'contract CometExt is CometExtInterface', delegatecall extension): baseIndexScale() returns BASE_INDEX_SCALE, factorScale() returns FACTOR_SCALE, priceScale() returns PRICE_SCALE, maxAssets() returns MAX_ASSETS, baseAccrualScale() returns BASE_ACCRUAL_SCALE, totalsBasic() returns TotalsBasic memory (CometExtInterface: 'abstract contract CometExtInterface is CometCore'; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/compound-finance/comet/f766f51583c23acc33b2a7824654ef2029a96804/contracts/CometExtInterface.sol). facts.value: cUSDCv3 = 'the main proxy contract for interacting with the first Compound III market'; 'The v3 proxy is the only address to be used to interact with a Compound III instance.'
facts.note: Networks section: 'The initial deployment of Compound III is on Ethereum and the base asset is USDC.' Protocol Contracts: cUSDCv3 (proxy), cUSDCv3 Implementation ('the implementation of the market logic contract, as deployed by the Comet Factory via the Configurator'), cUSDCv3 Ext ('an extension of the market logic contract which supports some auxiliary/independent interfaces'), Configurator, Proxy Admin ('the admin of the Comet and Configurator proxy contracts'), Comet Factory, Rewards, Bulker. The docs site does not itself list per-network addresses; it delegates to the repo deployments/ folder. docs.compound.finance/helper-functions/: userBasic struct 'principal, baseTrackingIndex, baseTrackingAccrued, assetsIn'; totalsBasic 'baseSupplyIndex, baseBorrowIndex, trackingSupplyIndex, trackingBorrowIndex...'; baseIndexScale 'The integer used to scale down the index when calculating a decimal value.'; factorScale 'The integer used to scale down the factor when calculating a decimal value.'; maxAssets 'The maximum number of assets that can be simultaneously supported by Compound III.'
